What about my RMA for the BSB Nerdqaxe++. The V. died after about 2 weeks atstock settings

Sorry, that one's on us to sort. Stock settings and a dead VRM two weeks in is exactly what RMA covers.

Start here: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

Put Shop···· on it and you'll get a return label. Processing runs up to 10 days after it reaches the warehouse. For the record, tampered or overclocked units aren't covered, but that's not your case.

I'm confirming the exact warranty terms for your unit rather than quoting a number. Did it die outright, or does it still power on?
It powers but gives a guru error for voltage regulation

That error can come from the PSU sagging rather than the board itself. Quickest check: run it on a different known-good supply of the same rating and see if the fault clears. If it does, we send a PSU on its own, no need to return the miner.

If it still throws the voltage fault on a second supply, it's the board and the RMA form is the path.

Do you have another supply you can try it with?
I will try it

Sounds good. If a second supply clears it, tell me and I'll get a PSU sent out on its own. If the fault stays, fill in the RMA form with Shop···· and a return label comes back to you.

The B.04 swap is already with the team either way.
